about_the_game:
Haley: Online - Private Profile Soundtrack

Step into Haley’s world with this exclusive official soundtrack!
Featuring 12 powerful and atmospheric tracks, the very ones Haley loves most.

Whether you’re reliving your favorite moments from the game or simply looking for an unforgettable listening experience, these MP3 tracks will transport you straight into Haley’s world.

content_descriptors.notes:
While Haley: Online – Private Profile may contain mature themes, this Official Soundtrack focuses purely on its music and atmosphere.
Please note that some songs include explicit language and strong lyrics, and may not be suitable for all audiences.
